# SubcriticalReservoir

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reservoir computing architecture deliberately maintained in a subcritical regime (branching ratio < 1) to ensure stable, reproducible outputs for practical neuromorphic applications. This design choice addresses hardware reliability constraints in iNEST, trading some computational richness for robustness in physical implementations.
